note: A quantum complexity theorist responds to Physical Superintelligence's claimed proof, produced with a proprietary harness on an internal Claude model, of the conjecture he posed with Ambainis. He says he has not yet understood it himself but accepts it on the strength of a Lean certificate and expert checking, and argues it rules out only a class of quantum speedups few expected, not quantum supremacy or Shor's algorithm.
title: Aaronson-Ambainis Conjecture proved! (By AI, of course)
